in_sanskrit.name: ओमवीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is brave and fearless, and carries the sacred syllable 'Om' in their heart.

in_hindi.name: ओमवीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: वीर: brave, heroic, fearless. ओम: the sacred syllable, symbolizing the divine presence and consciousness.

in_tamil.name: ஓம்விர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஓம்: ஓம் (ஓம்கார்) - the sacred syllable, symbolizing the divine presence and consciousness. விர்: விர் (விரகம்) - fearless, brave.

in_telugu.name: ొమ్వీర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ొమ్: ొమ్ (ొమ్కార్) - the sacred syllable, symbolizing the divine presence and consciousness. వీర్: వీర్ (వీజేయోళ) - fearless, brave.

in_marathi.name: Omvir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omvir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Omvir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Om' which represents the divine and the protector. The name is believed to bring blessings and protection to the bearer.
